data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: merge-to-main.sh consumes dso.workflow directly without legacy keys (GREEN phase)

## Implementation
Rewrite the strategy-reading section of `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh`:

**Current (lines 37-57):** reads `merge.strategy` directly via `grep '^merge\.strategy='`

**New approach:**
1. Call `bash "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-config.sh" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null`
2. Map `dso.workflow` to strategy: `ci-pr` → exec `merge-to-main-pr.sh`; `local` → exec `merge-to-main-direct.sh`
3. Default to `local` (exec `merge-to-main-direct.sh`) if dso.workflow is empty
4. Update error messages to reference `dso.workflow` not `merge.strategy`
5. Update `--resume` cross-strategy check: state file stores `dso_workflow` (or map to pr/direct for comparison)
6. Remove `MERGE_STRATEGY` variable usage; replace with `_workflow` variable
7. Update the final `exec "merge-to-main-${MERGE_STRATEGY}.sh"` to exec based on dso.workflow value

Key mapping:
- `dso.workflow=ci-pr` → exec `merge-to-main-pr.sh` (same as old `merge.strategy=pr`)
- `dso.workflow=local` or empty → exec `merge-to-main-direct.sh` (same as old `merge.strategy=direct`)

Note: The NOTE message about `merge.strategy not set` should become a NOTE about `dso.workflow not set`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] merge-to-main.sh no longer greps for merge.strategy
  Verify: ! grep -q "grep.*merge\.strategy\|merge\.strategy=" plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh || grep -q 'dso\.workflow' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh
- [ ] merge-to-main.sh reads dso.workflow via read-config.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'dso\.workflow' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh
- [ ] Given dso.workflow=ci-pr config, dispatcher routes to merge-to-main-pr.sh (stub test)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] RED markers removed from .test-index for dispatcher tests
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script\]' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Implement merge-to-main.sh: route on dso.workflow instead of merge.strategy (local->direct, ci-pr->pr)
